column1: # Ash Jenna's optional post-Colosso Vale super boss and optional Suhalla Gate fight.

column3:
I remember these roads.
I know which door
your mother waits behind.{page_break}Strange how much
has stayed the same.{end_wait}
Don't go near her.\nLeave Vale alone.{end_wait}

You can't protect
every house at once.{page_break}Shall we see how far
your strength goes
when it's your home?{end_wait}

You won. For now.{page_break}Go home, Isaac.
Tell her you're safe.{page_break}I wonder how long
you'll keep
that promise.{end_wait}

Those guards are hurt.
I didn't touch them.
I didn't have to.{page_break}I don't have to
hurt someone myself
to make them suffer.{end_wait}
They're hurt.\nGet out of the way.\nWe need to help them.{end_wait}

I can keep you here.
Every moment we fight
is time they don't have.{page_break}Go on, Isaac.
Let's see how much
your strength is worth.{end_wait}

You won, Isaac.
Those guards are
still waiting.{page_break}I hope you didn't
take too long.{end_wait}
I know your plan.\nIt won't work.

Idiots.
Did you think I'd miss
such a cheap trick?{page_break}Lean on tricks and
this is what you get.
